questions.question_text: Read the provided unseen passage tracking the evolution of artificial intelligence in modern healthcare. Based on the passage, what is the primary advantage of utilizing AI algorithms in preliminary medical diagnostics?
options: A) AI completely replaces the need for human physicians in surgical procedures.
B) AI algorithms can rapidly analyze massive datasets of medical imagery to detect microscopic anomalies earlier than traditional methods.
C) AI systems independently prescribe complex medication regimens without regulatory oversight.
D) AI drastically reduces the cost of building new hospital infrastructure.
questions.answer: B) AI algorithms can rapidly analyze massive datasets of medical imagery to detect microscopic anomalies earlier than traditional methods.

questions.question_text: According to the passage, which significant ethical concern do critics frequently raise regarding the implementation of AI in healthcare?
options: A) The potential for compromised patient data privacy and algorithmic bias affecting treatment equity.
B) The excessive physical space required to house modern supercomputers in clinics.
C) The AI's inability to comprehend basic anatomical terminology.
D) The fact that patients prefer interacting exclusively with robotic interfaces.
questions.answer: A) The potential for compromised patient data privacy and algorithmic bias affecting treatment equity.

questions.question_text: Choose the word from the passage that functions as an exact synonym for 'essential' or 'crucial'.
questions.answer: B) Indispensable

questions.question_text: Based on your reading of the passage, explain how machine learning models improve their diagnostic accuracy over extended periods of time. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Machine learning models improve their diagnostic accuracy by continuously processing and analyzing vast quantities of new patient data. As they ingest more diverse medical cases and outcomes, the algorithms refine their pattern recognition capabilities, reducing long-term error rates.

questions.question_text: What collaborative approach does the author suggest to maximize the benefits of AI while mitigating its inherent risks in medical environments? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The author suggests a 'human-in-the-loop' collaborative approach. This means utilizing AI as a powerful supplementary tool to assist human doctors, ensuring that final critical medical decisions remain guided by human empathy, clinical experience, and ethical judgment.

questions.question_text: Provide a suitable and concise title for the provided reading passage that accurately reflects its core thematic focus. [5-10 words]
questions.answer: The Integration of AI in Modern Healthcare: Benefits and Challenges.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Select the option that correctly completes the sentence by maintaining appropriate Subject-Verb Concord: 'The committee, along with its designated chairperson, ______ scheduled to review the revised annual budget tomorrow.'
questions.answer: C) is

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form of the verb given in brackets: 'By the time the rescue team finally arrived at the remote cabin, the stranded hikers ______ (consume) all their emergency rations.'
questions.answer: B) had consumed

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given direct statement into Reported Speech: 'The principal said, "All students must submit their project reports by Friday."'
options: A) The principal says that all students must submit their project reports by Friday.
B) The principal said that all students had to submit their project reports by Friday.
C) The principal said that all students must submit their project reports by Friday.
D) The principal told that all students submit their project reports on Friday.
questions.answer: B) The principal said that all students had to submit their project reports by Friday.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct Modal verb to express a strong obligation in the following sentence: 'Citizens ______ strictly adhere to the new traffic regulations to prevent severe accidents on the highway.'
questions.answer: C) must

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate Determiner: 'Despite searching the entire library archives, the researcher found very ______ reliable information regarding the ancient civilization.'
questions.answer: B) little

questions.question_text: Identify the error in the following sentence and supply the correction: 'Neither the manager nor the employees was aware of the sudden change in the corporate policy.'
questions.answer: C) Error: was / Correction: were

questions.question_text: Complete the sentence using the correct Tense structure: 'If the global temperatures continue to rise at this alarming rate, the polar ice caps ______ completely within the next century.'
questions.answer: C) will melt

questions.question_text: Select the correct option to fill in the blank expressing capability: 'Before the severe injury, the athlete ______ run a full marathon in under three hours without experiencing significant fatigue.'
questions.answer: B) could

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter to the Editor of a national newspaper expressing deep concern over the increasing incidents of cyberbullying among teenagers and suggesting preventive measures. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: Sir, I write to highlight the alarming surge in cyberbullying incidents targeting vulnerable teenagers on social media platforms. The cloak of digital anonymity emboldens perpetrators to harass peers, leading to severe psychological distress, depression, and anxiety among victims. It is imperative that schools integrate robust digital citizenship and cyber-safety modules into their curriculum. Furthermore, parents must actively monitor their children's online activities while fostering open communication channels. Social media companies should also implement stricter algorithmic reporting mechanisms to swiftly ban abusive accounts. Collective societal vigilance is necessary to create a safe digital environment for our youth. Yours sincerely, Rohan.

questions.question_text: Study the provided bar graph illustrating the rising trend of electronic waste (e-waste) generated in major metropolitan cities over the last five years. Write an Analytical Paragraph summarizing the data, making comparisons, and highlighting the environmental implications. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: The provided bar graph illustrates a steep and continuous upward trajectory in electronic waste generation across major metropolitan cities from 2019 to 2023. Starting at approximately 50,000 metric tons in 2019, the volume surged dramatically to nearly 120,000 metric tons by 2023, representing more than a twofold increase within just five years. This exponential growth strongly correlates with the rapid consumption and rapid obsolescence of digital devices like smartphones and laptops. The data highlights a severe impending environmental crisis, as improper disposal of e-waste releases toxic heavy metals into the soil and groundwater. The trend underscores an urgent need for sustainable recycling infrastructure and stricter electronic disposal regulations to mitigate ecological damage.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'A Letter to God'. Which phrase best describes Lencho's emotional state when he looked at his ruined cornfield?
options: D) Hopeful anticipation of the future
questions.answer: B) Absolute despair and sorrow

questions.question_text: In the poem 'Dust of Snow', what symbolic shift is represented when the crow shakes the hemlock tree?
options: A) A shift from winter to spring
B) A shift from a depressive mood to a sudden sense of upliftment and saved time
C) A shift indicating impending tragedy
D) A shift from morning to evening
questions.answer: B) A shift from a depressive mood to a sudden sense of upliftment and saved time

questions.question_text: How does the young seagull's mother ingeniously trick him into taking his first flight in 'His First Flight'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The mother tricks him by flying close to his ledge with a piece of fish but halting just out of reach. Maddened by intense hunger, the young seagull instinctively dives at the food, falling outward and downward, which forces him to spread his wings and fly.

questions.question_text: Why does Anne Frank firmly believe that 'paper has more patience than people' in 'From the Diary of Anne Frank'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Anne believes paper is more patient because a diary silently absorbs all her innermost thoughts, fears, and frustrations without judgment, interruption, or betrayal. Unlike humans, who might grow bored or critical, paper provides a safe, uncomplaining space for her extreme isolation.

questions.question_text: In 'A Triumph of Surgery', what underlying flaw in Mrs. Pumphrey's character leads to Tricki's severe illness? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Mrs. Pumphrey’s primary flaw is her excessive, misguided affection and lack of discipline. She overfeeds Tricki with rich, unhealthy foods and provides zero physical exercise, mistakenly believing she is treating him well, which directly causes his severe lethargy and near-fatal obesity.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain the central irony in the story 'A Question of Trust' regarding Horace Danby's profession and his ultimate downfall. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The central irony is that Horace Danby, a meticulous and 'honorable' thief who prides himself on outsmarting security, is ultimately outsmarted and manipulated by another, more cunning young female thief, leading directly to his arrest for a robbery she committed.

questions.question_text: Analyze how Nelson Mandela's understanding of 'freedom' evolves from his childhood to his adulthood in 'Long Walk to Freedom'. How does this evolution shape his political destiny? [80-100 words]
questions.answer: In his childhood, Mandela's concept of freedom was narrow and personal; it meant running in the fields, roasting mealies, and riding bulls. It was an illusion of freedom restricted to his immediate desires. As he matured into a young man in Johannesburg, he realized his fundamental, honorable freedoms—to achieve his potential, earn his keep, and marry—were systematically denied by Apartheid. Ultimately, his understanding broadened exponentially: true freedom wasn't just his own, but the indivisible freedom of his entire community. This profound realization transformed him from a frightened young man into a bold political rebel, dedicating his life to the African National Congress to liberate his oppressed people, shaping his destiny as a global icon of resistance.

questions.question_text: Evaluate the character of Hari Singh in 'The Thief's Story'. What psychological factors ultimately prevent him from running away with Anil's money, highlighting the theme of redemption? [80-100 words]
questions.answer: Hari Singh is initially a cynical, calculating teenage thief who views Anil merely as an easy, trusting target. However, his interaction with Anil fundamentally alters his psychological landscape. Anil offers him something far more valuable than stolen money: trust, basic human dignity, and the promise of education. When Hari steals the money, he realizes that absconding means sacrificing his chance to become a literate, respected man. The guilt of breaking Anil's absolute trust weighs heavily on him. The transformative power of education and genuine human kindness acts as a catalyst for his redemption. He chooses to return the money, proving that even a hardened heart can be reformed through compassion and the prospect of a dignified future.
